study.assay: same-cell bone-marrow RNA and surface-protein counts
study.estimand: transfer of RNA-protein association from earlier acquisition batches to later acquisition batches at held-subject margins

allocation.rule: order the seven deposited acquisition batches by batch number; use the first four batches for source-only development and the final three batches for a sealed held test

frozen_file_binding.bound_contents: subject, batch, GSM, canonical per-sample URLs, file names, byte counts, and ordered cognate candidates

pre_protocol_axis_authorization.purpose: verify exact feature schemas and file digests before freezing the executable protocol
permitted_reads: RNA feature names and feature types
ADT feature names or CSV header

source_only_development.primary_family: hierarchical exact fixed-margin conditional coupling field
source_only_development.source_promotion_gate: the primary must fit validly, beat the best source-selected residual in leave-one-batch-out loss, and retain at least nine exact cognate markers; otherwise the branch closes without held numeric access

held_decision.primary_loss: subject-equal mean multinomial deviance over the frozen ordered RNA-to-ADT panel
held_decision.transfer_pass: at least 5% lower mean loss than the source-selected residual and destroyed-link control, paired bootstrap upper endpoint below zero for both loss differences, and at least 8 of 9 held subjects favorable against the residual
held_decision.classical_increment: reported separately; supported only when the primary point loss is lower than both the common-effect exact conditional and pooled saturated-Poisson estimates and both paired-bootstrap upper endpoints are below zero

prior_branch.reason: its GSE288020 source authorization required five valid source methods and external_study_ready=true; that source gate failed
prior_branch.relationship_to_this_candidate: this is a new within-study batch-held analysis, not a repair or rerun of the unavailable cross-study protocol

access_attestation.before_this_designation: one source-subject RNA feature-name axis and one source-subject ADT header/feature-name axis were inspected to establish format feasibility; no barcode, identifier, numeric assay value, pairing, association, or loss was read
